message.content:
The value of $20 in British pounds depends on the current USD/GBP exchange rate, which fluctuates throughout the day. As of the most recent market data (late 2023 – early 2024), the rate has been hovering around **1 USD ≈ 0.77 GBP**. Using that figure:

\[
\$20 \times 0.77 \;\text{GBP/USD} \;\approx\; £15.40
\]

So, roughly **£15.40** is what you’d get for $20 at that rate.

> **Quick note:**  
> • Exchange rates change constantly due to market forces.  
> • If you need a precise amount for a transaction, check a reliable financial news source, your bank’s website, or a currency‑conversion app at the time of the transfer.
